# @personaai/runtime 0.10.0

`@personaai/runtime` is the framework-agnostic runtime engine for [Persona](https://persona.hasanraiyan.me). It sits directly on your backend between your host HTTP server and the Persona Developer Platform API, managing real-time chat streams, session-level reconnection, lifecycle hooks, tool manifests, and security boundaries.

Every framework adapter ([`@personaai/adapters/express`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index), [`@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index), [`@personaai/adapters/nestjs`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index)) is a thin translation layer over this single engine.

> **Server-Side Only:** `@personaai/runtime` holds your Project API credential. Never bundle or import this package into client-side code or browser applications.

```bash
npm install @personaai/runtime
```

---

## Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       Client Layer                          │
│   @personaai/react (useChat, useVoice, useThreads, etc.)    │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │  HTTP / SSE
┌──────────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
│                    Host Adapter Layer                       │
│   @personaai/adapters (Express / Next.js / NestJS / Node)   │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │  RuntimeRequest / RuntimeResponse
┌──────────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
│                    @personaai/runtime                       │
│  - resolveUser() Auth Contract   - RunDriver & SSE Pump     │
│  - Resumable Streams & Buffer    - Heartbeats (15s gaps)    │
│  - 11 Async Lifecycle Hooks      - 2-Tier Security Model    │
│  - REST Tool & RCP Manifests     - Error Sanitizer          │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │  PersonaClient
┌──────────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
│             Persona Developer Platform API                  │
│       (LangGraph / AG-UI / Qdrant / Gemini Live)            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Core Tenets

### 1. Framework-Neutral Contract
The runtime has no dependency on Node.js `http`, Express, Next.js, or NestJS. It exposes a single interface:

```ts
export interface Runtime {
  handle(request: RuntimeRequest): Promise<RuntimeResponse>;
  close(): void;
}
```

Any host environment that can parse an incoming request into a [`RuntimeRequest`](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/guides/custom-host) and stream a [`RuntimeResponse`](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/guides/custom-host) can run Persona agents.

### 2. Strict Authentication Boundary (`resolveUser`)
Persona **never authenticates end users**. The runtime expects your host application to determine who is making the request:

```ts
import{} from '@personaai/runtime';

const runtime = createRuntime({
  baseUrl: process.env.PERSONA_BASE_URL!,
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
  resolveUser: async (request) => {
    // Extract session token, cookie, or JWT from request.headers
    const session = await authenticateUser(request.headers['authorization']);
    return session?.userId ?? null; // Returning null responds with 401
  },
});
```

The resolved `userId` scopes all conversation threads, uploaded files, and memory files. See [User Resolver Guide](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/guides/resolve-user).

### 3. Two-Tier Security Surface
All routes in the runtime belong to one of two trust tiers:
- **Always-on (End-User Tier):** Operations safe for logged-in end users (`POST /chat`, `GET /threads`, `POST /voice/sessions`, `POST /files`, `GET /memory`, etc.).
- **Opt-in (`capabilities.*` — Admin Tier):** Project-level configuration (`providers` with LLM keys, `skills`, `knowledge` vector stores, `stores`, `auditLogs`, `architect`). Every capability **defaults to `false`** to prevent accidental exposure. See [Capabilities Guide](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/routes/capabilities).

### 4. Resumable Streaming (`RunDriver`)
Mid-stream network disconnects do not kill agent execution. The runtime’s internal `RunDriver` continues buffering the AG-UI event stream. Clients can reconnect at `GET /chat/:runId/resume?since=<seq>` to replay missed frames without repeating turns. See [Streaming & Resume Guide](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/guides/streaming-and-resume).
